time_shape.evidence: Length 0.600 s is inside 0.3-0.9 s. The waveform picture shows a steady train of ticks that visibly gets denser toward the end, with the loudness curve rising smoothly (150 ms LUFS about -24 to -13). But the onset detector reports only 1 onset (0.000) because the ticks merge, density says just 50 events/s average (30 in 0.6 s, min spacing 4 ms), and the ramp-up attack (0.499 s to the peak at 0.58 s) with no decay means the rise in rate is shown by eye, not by a measured onset spacing.

spectrum.evidence: Centroid 6.54k/6.28k/6.14k Hz (whole 6.22k) is inside 3-8 kHz; rolloff 8.8k->8.1k; 2k-8k holds 83% of energy and >8k 17%; band table is dominated by 4k and 8k+ at every segment (about -31/-29 dB at start, -21/-21 dB at end), nothing below 1 kHz. But the brief wants the pitch to rise after the rate rises: pitch is 'none (voiced 0%)' and the centroid falls by tenths 6.55k->6.03k instead of rising. The spectrogram shows only a lower edge shifting from about 2k to 1k Hz, which is broadband spread, not a rising pitch.

parts.evidence: The rate-rising tick train is separately visible: the waveform shows ticks from roughly 15-20/s at the start to dense by 0.5 s, and the speed sweep (end rate knob, 0/0.5/1) changes how dense the end is. The 'then pitch' component is not visible: no pitch track, no rising partial lines in the spectrogram, modes cluster 5.4k-6.9k Hz (sustained, inharmonic, 357 cents).

control_variation.evidence: 3 macros (brightness, rattle, speed). Claims brightness (centroid up) and rattle (crest down) both PASS in verify; speed unclaimed but moves the picture clearly. Brightness 0 -> 1 keeps centroid 5.3k -> 7.7k Hz, inside 3-8k. Seeds 1-4 differ measurably (LUFS -18.3/-18.1/-18.0/-17.7, attack 0.499 vs 0.481 s, true peak -3.0 vs -2.8) and all stay in range, though the tiles look alike apart from comb ripple.

notes: Master level never decays: the sound ends at its peak (peak at 0.58 s of 0.60 s) and is cut by the 5 ms output fade; decay -20 dB 'never'. A zipper may want that, but there is no tail.
The 'rattle' macro at 0 makes the onset detector see 4 onsets and a density of 90 events/s, and at 1 hides them (1 onset): its effect on the tick train is large and not a pure crest control.
